rubric_content.text_property: The agent maintains a warm, professional, and empathetic tone appropriate for healthcare appointment discussions.
The agent clearly states the specific date, time, provider name, and clinic name when offering the rescheduled appointment.
The agent respects the patient's decision whether they accept or decline the appointment, and handles objections with empathy.
When the patient raises concerns (billing, timing, availability), the agent addresses them directly and clearly.
Before ending the call, the agent confirms whether the appointment was rescheduled or if the patient declined.
The reschedule_appointment tool is only called after the patient explicitly agrees to the new appointment time.
The send_confirmation_sms tool is only called after successfully rescheduling the appointment, not before.
The end_call tool is only called when the conversation is naturally complete, either after rescheduling or when the patient declines.
